rules: Every traceable proposition must be measured.
PASS requires an exact authenticated trace and every applicable non-compensatory gate.
RETRY is temporary and requires the missing trace, owner, next distinct action, remaining budget, and exit condition.
Phenomenal-resource recovery permits exactly two distinct search rounds; only round one may return RETRY.
An incomplete second round returns VETO, GYROPHARE_TRACE_ABSENTE_APRES_DEUX_RECHERCHES, HALLUCINATION_BLOQUANTE_OU_PHENOMENE_INEXISTANT, and RETOUR_ENVOYEUR.
Contradiction, tampering, fabricated evidence, unsigned claimed measurement, and forbidden execution are VETO.
A missing trace never produces a numeric placeholder or pseudo-result.
No fourth decision state, alias, synonym, enum value, or display label is allowed.
